headline: Fund billing/support next quarter, led by BIL-PAYWALL, the top actionable issue and the area whose complaint share rose most steeply at the end of the window

recommendations.rationale: BIL-PAYWALL is the top actionable issue by priority score and carries many cancellation-language records.
recommendations.title: Fund BIL-PAYWALL fixes first

recommendations.rationale: Billing/support share rose sharply in the last full month, which confirms the case for prioritising it now.
recommendations.title: Act on the end-of-window billing/support surge

recommendations.rationale: USA-ADS is a strong runner-up with reliable labels, and the billing/usability boundary overlaps.
recommendations.title: Pair with a usability ads review

recommendations.rationale: Playback is larger over the full period but its labels are less certain, and ACC-LOGIN is very severe but small.
